HEBR 125.d: An introduction to Biblical Hebrew with emphasis on grammar and vocabulary. Cross-list: RELI 125.
HEBR 125.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

HEBR 141.d: Development of interactional competence in Hebrew (sociolinguistic and sociocultural knowledge) to communicate and interact with speakers of Hebrew. The course is based on a student-centered, critical-thinking approach to language analysis/acquisition. No prior knowledge of this language is necessary. Effective May 15, 2019, this course does not carry D1 credit. Mutually Exclusive: Cannot register for HEBR 141 if student has credit for HEBR 161.
HEBR 141.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

HEBR 126.d: Continuation of RELI 125. We will finish the grammar in the second half of this semester and then read selections from the Hebrew Bible. Cross-list: RELI 126.
HEBR 126.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.

HEBR 142.d: Continuation of HEBR 141. Development of interactional competence in Hebrew (sociolinguistic and socio cultural knowledge) to communicate and interact with speakers of Hebrew. The course is based on a student-centered, critical-thinking approach to language analysis/acquisition. Effective May 15, 2019, this course does not carry D1 credit. Recommended Prerequisite(s): HEBR 101. Mutually Exclusive: Cannot register for HEBR 142 if student has credit for HEBR 262.
HEBR 142.restr: Enrollment is limited to Undergraduate, Undergraduate Professional or Visiting Undergraduate level students.
